drafts.title: Registrar abuse report to Dynadot Inc
drafts.subject: Phishing / brand impersonation: portal-hydrex.xyz impersonates Hydrex
drafts.body:
DRAFT - NOT FILED. File only after the brand owner approves it and has signed a Letter of Authorisation.

Hello Dynadot Inc abuse team,

The domain portal-hydrex[.]xyz (registered with you on 2026-09-23) is being used to impersonate Hydrex, a crypto project whose official site is hxxps://hydrex[.]fi. We ask you to suspend the domain under your abuse policy and the RAA section 3.18 obligations.

Evidence (observed 2026-11-01, read-only, URLs defanged):
- URL: hxxps://portal-hydrex[.]xyz/
- Brand name plus a phishing lure word
- Page title resembles the official title (100%)
- Page text overlaps the official site (20% shingles)
- Brand named on the page (8x), including the title
- Wallet-connect prompt/library: Connect your wallet, walletconnect, reown.com
- Drainer-style JS: obfuscated-js(300 _0x identifiers)
- Lure text: claim, Rewards
- Resolves to 188.114.96.11, 188.114.97.11
- Page title: "Hydrex"
- Screenshot: shots/portal-hydrex.xyz.jpg (attach)

We are not affiliated with the operator of portal-hydrex[.]xyz. Hydrex has not authorised its use of the brand. Screenshots and HTML captures are available on request.

Regards,
{{REPORTER_NAME}}
{{REPORTER_ORG}}, acting for Hydrex under a Letter of Authorisation dated {{LOA_DATE}}
{{REPORTER_EMAIL}}
